correctedState: The /context category dimension is fully implemented and live-proven. `ContextUsageCategoryId` (packages/core/src/types/message.ts:531) enumerates exactly the seven documented categories, with a doc comment citing this page. `ContextUsageSnapshot` carries optional `categories`, `loadedFiles`, `unattributedTokens` and `suggestions` alongside the totals (message.ts:631-646). The producer packages/pi-agent-server/src/context-categories.ts:159-171 emits all seven rows measured with `estimateTokens` over the production-composed strings, and populates the per-subagent `source` from descriptor provenance (:143), satisfying the sentence's 'with the source each loaded from' clause. The renderer overlay apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/context-overlay.tsx renders the seven labelled rows plus the loaded-file list, reached via the /context slash command (slash-command-actions.ts:104). Parity row R11 is closed (done, CDP pass 9; demoted and re-closed 2026-07-30 by 3335307a for an mcp_tools/system_tools split defect), and the suggestions follow-up N2 is closed by 6b781302.
